function.name: check_availability
function.description: Find up to three free appointment times for a service. Call this before offering times to the caller.

service.description: Service the caller wants, in their words, e.g. "ladies cut" or "beard trim"

date.description: Preferred day as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to search the next 7 days.

around.description: Preferred time as HH:MM, if the caller named one

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book one of the times returned by check_availability, after the caller confirmed it and gave their name.

start.description: The start value of the chosen slot, e.g. 2026-09-24T14:00

phone.description: Only if different from the number the caller is calling from

function.name: find_appointments
function.description: List the caller's upcoming bookings, identified by the number they are calling from.

function.name: cancel_appointment
function.description: Cancel one of the caller's upcoming bookings. Without a reference, cancels the only booking or asks which one.

function.name: reschedule_appointment
function.description: Move one of the caller's bookings to a new time. Check availability first.
